ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes to low-intensity black pixels localized in the central peduncle region and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes display contiguous white fields. Left lobe (viewer perspective) shows dense black mottling and speckling across 70% of its white surface. Right lobe contains a cleaner white field with discrete, isolated black focal spots and a centralized circular dark feature. The central peduncle area is a solid, low-intensity black region extending from the base to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70 degrees; the notch depth occupies roughly 18% of the total visible vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; amplitudes of individual peaks are greatest at the distal tips, becoming more regular and low-amplitude as they approach the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer trailing edges exhibit a convex trajectory, sweeping upward and outward to sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: One prominent circular dark-pixel cluster located in the center-right quadrant of the right lobe; cluster of dark circular spots on the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct high-intensity white linear streak oriented at a 45-degree angle on the inner dark portion of the right lobe; several faint, horizontal gray scratches visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal white scar on the right inner lobe; circular dark-pigmented lesion or scar on the mid-right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy, non-uniform black-on-white mottling pattern unique to the left ventral lobe surface.
